name: LensGuard
author: Shirak Semonian
description: Camera activity guard for the Omarchy bar: quietly watches which process holds /dev/video* open and clearly shows when the webcam is in use. Whitelisted apps (zoom, obs, teams, chrome, ...) stay calm yellow; an unknown process triggers a red alert with one notification naming command and PID. Panel shows live details, event history and whitelist management. No service, no key, no network.

barWidget.description: Camera activity guard — shows when a process uses the webcam
